capabilities: Import Google Takeout Google Keep backup notes and attachments
Batch-import arbitrary binary files from a folder
Map Keep labels, colours, pinned and archived states to Obsidian tags
Customise import folders, creation dates and filename character mapping
Log unsupported files skipped during import
extras: Author states the plugin is no longer maintained and recommends the official Obsidian Importer plugin, which he contributed Keep import functionality to.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to import exported Google Keep notes with their attachments, labels, colours and dates.

relations.evidence: try using the official Obsidian Importer plugin instead

summary: Import plugin that converts exported Google Keep backup notes and their attachments from Google Takeout into Obsidian notes.
